item.title: Bucks County Brewers Meet for Third Annual County-Wide Bucks County Ale Trail Beer Collaboration
item.description: Visit Bucks County partnered with host, Warwick Farm Brewing, and the brewers of Bucks County to release the third county-wide Bucks County Ale Trail collaboration beer, Expedition Bucks County, a 5.0% Pilsner, brewed Motueka Hops. The beer recipe and label were redesigned for the collaboration’s third year, with the beer actively brewing during the event.

item.title: Enjoy Fall in Bucks County, the #1 Fall Foliage Destination in the U.S.
item.description: Located less than an hour from Philadelphia and 90 minutes from New York City, Bucks County is the perfect spot for cozy small towns, scenic drives, and crisp seasonal experiences. Bucks County offers a variety of ways to experience its acclaimed fall foliage. From the charming shops of Peddler’s Village to the historic streets of New Hope, there’s something for everyone.

item.title: Bucks County, PA Named #1 Fall Foliage Destination in PA
item.description: Bucks County, Pennsylvania, has once again been named a top leaf-peeping destination in the United States for 2025, according to a search analysis from Priceline.

item.title: Visit Bucks County Shares Visitation Data and Marketing Strategies at 2025 Annual Event
item.description: More than 200 tourism and hospitality professionals and local organizations gathered at Visit Bucks County’s (VBC) Annual Event on Wednesday, October 15.

item.title: Bucks County makes National Headlines as Sabrina Carpenter and Gigi Hadid Shoutout Their Hometown
item.description: Bucks County native Sabrina Carpenter brought back her “Short n’ Sweet” tour Thursday evening, with Gigi Hadid in the audience – both proudly shouting out their hometown, Bucks County!

item.title: Celebrate the Holidays in Bucks County, Pennsylvania
item.description: Create lasting memories in Bucks County this holiday season, where New Hope shines as one of America’s Top Christmas Towns, Byers’ Choice®, brings a life-sized London Street to life with its famous handcrafted Caroler® figures, and Perkasie celebrates its historic Christmas tree lighting.

item.title: Bucks County featured in The American Revolution premiere on PBS
item.description: Ken Burns’ new documentary series, The American Revolution, premieres November 16, 2025, on PBS. The six-part, 12-hour documentary series tells the story of America’s eight-year War for Independence and how experiences, conflicts and ideals shaped the Revolution.

item.title: Vogue Features Bucks County, Pennsylvania
item.description: Bucks County has once again captured national media attention as one of “The Best Christmas Towns in the USA for a Dose of Holiday Cheer,” in a recent holiday travel roundup by Vogue.

item.title: What’s Ahead in Bucks County, PA in 2026
item.description: Bucks County is gearing up for an exciting year filled with lodging and attraction openings, new exhibits and family-friendly festivals. A visit to Bucks County is a must this year. To help plan your visit, Visit Bucks County has rounded up a list of what's to come.
